description: 嘉義市公有廳舍太陽能光電屋頂建置地點及發電量 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 嘉義市政府. 提供嘉義市公有廳舍屋頂建置太陽能光電發電系統地點及累計發電量資料. Coverage: 嘉義市政府. The portal files it under the publisher 嘉義市政府. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
